retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1980s pop aesthetic featuring a dynamic female subject in animal print against a clean studio background with bold, layered graphic elements.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a woman in eclectic leopard-print attire, positioned to the right, balanced by a large, stylized brush-stroke name and a geometric circular emblem on the left, all set against a neutral off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dynamic wide-legged stance creates a triangular base for the composition.
The large brush-script text overlaps the geometric emblem to create depth.
The warm orange and tan tones of the animal print are mirrored in the primary typography.
The subject's gaze and arm placement guide the eye toward the central graphic cluster.
coreInvariants: Bold, hand-painted brush texture in the main title
Geometric circular logo with starburst or compass motifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, standing in a wide, confident pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, orange brush-script initial 'S' acts as the primary visual anchor on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the arm down to the text, and then sweeps across the wide stance of the boots.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white negative space surrounds the subject and graphics, emphasizing the 80s studio look.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background provides a clean canvas for busy patterns.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep orange and black provide high-contrast definition for text and animal spots.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal, purple, and yellow appear within the geometric emblem.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange text and warm tan prints against a low-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon greens or bright pinks to maintain the specific late-80s earth-tone pop palette.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Slanted, aggressive script and wide-set sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick, textured brush strokes with visible bristle marks.
Letters are heavily italicized (slanted right) to imply speed and energy.
Secondary text follows a circular arc above the emblem.
Drop shadows are hard-edged and offset to the bottom-right.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial letter is significantly oversized with a long, sweeping tail.
The 'i' dots and crossbars are integrated into the brush flow.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A textured, organic brush script paired with a clean, geometric sans-serif following a path.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-painted energy of the era.
Matches the secondary arched text style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio photograph of a woman in 80s leopard print leggings and thigh-high boots, posing dynamically against a solid off-white background. Leave the left side of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, orange, dry-brush textured script name across the center-left, overlapping a multi-colored geometric starburst circle. Add a hard black drop shadow to the text.

verificationChecks: Is the brush texture visible in the main text?
Does the subject wear leopard/cheetah print?
Is the background a clean, neutral studio wall?
Is the text slanted to the right?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name or artist likeness.
Do not use the exact starburst logo design.
Ensure the brush script is a new custom creation.
postGenerationChecks: Check for hard-edged black drop shadows on text.
Verify the subject is positioned to the right of the text.
Ensure the brush script feels hand-painted, not typed.
Confirm the presence of a geometric circular element behind the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Animal Print Fashion + (Hand-Brushed Script * Hard Drop Shadow) + Geometric Emblem Overlay
